sections.heading: What is a managed website for a tree service company?
body: A managed website for a tree service company is a professionally designed website that SynergyFirst Digital hosts, maintains and supports for one monthly fee, with no upfront design fee. It is built around how people look for tree work: removal, trimming and stump grinding, the area you cover, and a fast way to call or request a quote.
Plans start at $249 per month with no activation fee, and every business can see a free, private preview before paying.

sections.heading: Why tree service websites lose jobs they should win
sections.intro: Tree work is high-stakes and often urgent. These are the gaps we see most often.

items.title: The phone number is hard to find
items.body: When a branch is on the roof or a tree is leaning, a number buried in a menu sends the customer to the next company.

items.title: Removal, trimming and stump grinding are mixed together
items.body: A storm clean-up, a pruning job and a stump are different needs. Without clear paths for each, visitors are unsure you handle theirs.

items.title: Customers cannot picture the work
items.body: Without clear photos of past jobs, it is hard for a homeowner to judge the kind of work you do.

items.title: The service area is unclear
items.body: If visitors cannot quickly tell whether you cover their town, they do not enquire.

items.title: No easy way to ask for a quote
items.body: Most tree jobs are quoted after a look at the site. A short request form captures customers who would rather write than call.

items.title: Safety and trust are left to chance
items.body: Licence and insurance details, reviews and past work belong where customers look for reassurance.

sections.heading: What we build into a tree service website
sections.intro: Every site is custom-designed around how your customers choose a tree service company.

items.title: Click-to-call on every page
items.body: Your number stays one tap away on phones, so urgent customers can reach you without searching.

items.title: Separate paths for removal, trimming and stump grinding
items.body: Clear service sections so each visitor lands on the job they need, with a call or quote request beside it.

items.title: Storm and emergency options
items.body: Give urgent jobs their own route, so a customer with a fallen tree knows what to do next.

items.title: Service-area clarity
items.body: State where you work, so visitors can see straight away that you cover their location.

items.title: A home for photos, reviews and credentials
items.body: Space for before-and-after work and the trust signals you can genuinely show, placed where customers look for reassurance.

items.title: A simple quote-request form
items.body: A short, accessible form where customers describe the job and the tree, so you can plan the visit.
